subject: Vendor payment intake & remittance flow: Greenline Components
body:
From: Jordan Price <payments@greenline.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Getting set up — banking info + remit preferences

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We (Greenline Components) are ready to complete your vendor intake so we can start receiving POs and invoices. A few quick items so we can prepare: 

- Preferred payment method: ACH is preferred for us, but we can accept wire if needed.
- Do you require a bank confirmation letter or are micro-deposits acceptable?
- What's the remittance email/address we should use on invoices?
- Any PO requirements or special invoice fields we should include?

I attached our W-9 for your records.

Best,
Jordan Price
AP Lead, Greenline Components
payments@greenline.io
[Attachment: Greenline_W9.pdf (application/pdf)]

------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <payments@greenline.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Getting set up — banking info + remit preferences

Hi Jordan — thanks for sending the W-9 and for the clear list. Welcome — happy to get this moving.

Quick overview of our standard vendor intake and payment expectations:

1) Documents we need to complete vendor setup:
   - Signed W-9 (received) or equivalent tax form if outside the US.
   - Completed Redwood vendor form (attached). Please fill and return.
   - Bank confirmation (bank letter on bank letterhead) OR we can verify via micro-deposits — bank letter speeds things up.

2) Payment methods and fees:
   - ACH: default for recurring domestic payments. No fee to vendor.
   - Wire: used on request (typically for expedited payments or international transfers). Redwood charges a $15 wire processing fee that may be deducted from the payment unless otherwise agreed.

3) Invoice and PO requirements:
   - Submit invoices to: invoices@redwood-inference.com (this drives automated ingest).
   - Include any Redwood PO number on the invoice header. If we issue a PO it will appear as PO#XXXXXX. Invoices without a PO may be routed to manual review and delay payment.
   - PDF invoices preferred; include line items and the remit contact/email on the invoice body.

4) Payment terms:
   - Standard terms are Net 30 from date of invoice receipt for new vendors.
   - For some initial onboarding or negotiated cases we can confirm Net 45 or alternate cadence — finance will flag exceptions.

I've attached our vendor ACH form for you to complete and return with the bank confirmation. Once we receive the form + confirmation + W-9 we'll kick vendor setup and let you know the vendor ID and PO process timeline. Expected verification time for bank letter submissions is 2–4 business days; micro-deposits can take 3 business days to clear.

Attach: Redwood_ACH_Form_2027.pdf (please return completed)

Next steps:
- Jordan: please return completed ACH form and bank confirmation (or confirm you'd like to do micro-deposits).
- Marissa / Vivek: can you confirm any additional finance requirements for new vendors >$100k ARR?

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Vendor Enablement, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com

------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Jordan Price <payments@greenline.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@greenline.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Getting set up — banking info + remit preferences

Thanks, Soojin.

Attached is a bank confirmation letter from our bank and a completed copy of the W-9. We do prefer ACH.

Bank (sample data):
Bank: First Pacific Bank
Account name: Greenline Components, Inc.
Routing: 122000024
Account #: ******1234

Attached: Greenline_Bank_Confirmation.pdf, Greenline_W9.pdf

—Jordan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <payments@greenline.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:20:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Getting set up — Getting you across the finish line

Hi Jordan — welcome, and thanks for sending the bank letter. A few operational notes from Finance to expedite setup: 

- Verification: bank letter on bank letterhead is sufficient; we will still run a quick validation (no micro-deposit needed if letter provided).
- ACH form: please complete the attached Redwood_ACH_Form_2027.pdf with the full account number and sign.
- Tax: W-9 received and acceptable.
- Invoice format best practices: single PDF per invoice, include PO number if provided, include remit email and vendor name on cover page.
- Payment schedule: once vendor is active we follow Net 30. First payment timing depends on receipt + PO match; allow up to 1–2 payment cycles.
- Wires: for any one-off expedited wire requests please include a short justification and note our $15 processing fee (we can bill back or deduct).

Attach: Redwood_ACH_Form_2027.pdf (application/pdf)

If you return the completed ACH form today we can aim to have Greenline live in our vendor master by EOD Wednesday and accept POs by next week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
